description: On any given Contact, not every kid is piloting. The ones who aren't play at ground level, in real danger, with real agency — never touching combat math directly.

rules.dcSource: Ground-role DCs are set by the task the kid is attempting, not by the enemy's level. A level-1 kid never rolls against a level-12 Claimant's DC.
rules.encounterDesign: Ground encounters use hazards and environment, never enemy statblocks — a level-1 party should never trade blows with a Claimant directly.
rules.rotation: Rotate roles fight to fight. Nobody should play the same one twice in a row once the roster settles.

roles.name: Sensor Operator
roles.description: Recall Knowledge checks reveal the Claimant's weaknesses, resistances, immunities. Each success = one true fact the pilot can act on.

roles.name: Umbilical Control
roles.description: Success converts an external round of effort into a saved internal-power round for the Frame.

roles.name: Evacuation Marshal
roles.description: Runs the civilian casualty track. Failures here become next episode's Resonance penalties.

roles.name: Structural Command
roles.description: Demolition charges, sluice gates, controlled collapses. Changes the map mid-fight.

roles.name: Signals Liaison
roles.description: Talks the pilot down: reduces Bleed, or holds a slipping Resonance band. Strongest when they share an Anchor with their pilot.
